standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the further point r with s(r) = u, t(r) = u'.

core_obligations: Reduce U affine and surjective etale over X; pick u over x.
Given u' -> u over x, the presentation points give r' with s(r') = u', t(r') = u; the specialization lemma gives r with s(r) = u, t(r) = u'.
Then s(r), t(r) are points of U over x with s(r) -> t(r) -> s(r); by the final part of the U-finiteness lemma (no specializations within fibres) s(r) = t(r).
Conclude u = u': two points of the same fibre of |U| -> |X| that specialize to each other are equal (points-cartesian fibers of schemes are Kolmogorov).
proof_roadmap: Reduction; two lifting steps; collapse in the fibre; Kolmogorov finish.
difficulty_reason: A four-step collapse argument built on the carded specialization and no-specializations lemmas.
